material_reason: The only permitted official CNINFO metadata for the cited cutoff-before static PDF supplies an announcement date but no time-of-day or timezone-aware availability timestamp.  A1 requires every static source to carry an exact timestamp; date-only metadata cannot be promoted by inference.
missing_fact: An official, timezone-aware publication or availability instant for each source intended to support the A1 action, hypotheses, or strongest rival.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not infer a midnight timestamp from the CNINFO date.
Do not substitute the PDF URL date for a publication instant.
Do not use a later disclosure, result, price, or named comparator to cure this source-time defect.
economic_impact: No investor conclusion, action efficacy conclusion, comparator selection, or method claim can be drawn from this screen.  The candidate may remain a discovery lead, but it cannot enter the A1 comparator-recruitment path.
executable_remediation: A new independent source-acquisition pass may supply a cutoff-before official static filing whose metadata itself records a timezone-aware availability instant, with issuer, responsibility-unit, perimeter, page and support-role bindings.  It must be screened as a new receipt version before any A1 registration.
acceptance_criteria_for_retry: Every proposed static source has availability_precision TIMESTAMP.
Each published_at value is timezone-aware and strictly before the cutoff.
The official source, not an inferred date, supplies the availability instant.
The remaining A1 implementation, materiality, H-A, H-B, strongest-rival and same-boundary evidence gates are then independently rechecked.
